human_patches.why: Runs the script's own lines up to the model fit and skips the table formatting after it, which needs kableExtra.

spec.title: A timing model for a forest pest: the 1986 spread value of 1.559
spec.statement: Kemp, Dennis and Beckwith (1986) report a spread value of 1.559 in their model of spruce budworm life stages. This re-runs an independent R replication by Boersch-Supan, published in ReScience C. He notes that this value came out about 9% different, while the overall fit still agrees well with the original. A difference here is not a finding that the original work is wrong.

source.authors: Replication: P. H. Boersch-Supan. Original: W. P. Kemp, B. Dennis, R. C. Beckwith.

artifact.entrypoint: Rscript --vanilla -e "library(dplyr); e <- parse('code/03_fit_dennis_et_al_model.R'); for (x in e[3:5]) eval(x); cat(sprintf('spread %.6f\n', logit_cm_dennis_nll\$par[7]))" > rerun_output.txt

metric.name: spread value (b squared) of the logit model
